hook: Nvidia halted chip shipments to Southeast Asia.
hookText: Nvidia halts shipments to Southeast Asia

beats.say: Nvidia has told its manufacturing partners to stop shipping servers to four south-east Asian countries, as the US steps up export controls on AI computing power.
Partners such as Dell and Supermicro, which package Nvidia's chips into servers, told buyers in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia that their orders will not ship.
It is unclear whether the halt is temporary. The move comes as the US tries to prevent Chinese access to AI computing power, three people with knowledge of the matter say.
